name: Taj Mahal
headline: A Timeless Symbol of Love
description: One of the world's most iconic monuments, the Taj Mahal is celebrated for its magnificent white marble architecture, intricate craftsmanship, and its enduring story of love built by Emperor Shah Jahan for his beloved queen Mumtaz Mahal.

name: Mussoorie
headline: Queen of the Hills
description: Draped in cedar and oak, Mussoorie sits at 2,000 metres in the Garhwal Himalayas offering spectacular valley panoramas, colonial-era promenades, and a refreshing cool retreat from the plains throughout the year.

name: Kerala Backwaters
headline: Where Time Moves with the Tides
description: A labyrinth of shimmering lagoons, canals, and emerald paddy fields, the Kerala Backwaters offer an unhurried escape aboard traditional houseboats, with swaying palms and village life unfolding at a gentle pace.

name: Hawa Mahal
headline: Palace of the Winds
description: Rising five stories in delicate pink sandstone, Hawa Mahal's 953 latticed windows were designed to let royal ladies observe street festivals while remaining veiled — a breathtaking fusion of Rajput and Mughal artistry in the heart of Jaipur.

name: Pangong Lake
headline: A Mirror at the Roof of the World
description: At 4,350 metres altitude in Ladakh, Pangong Lake's surreal blue waters shift from sapphire to turquoise as the day unfolds, framed by stark Himalayan ridges in one of India's most remote and breathtaking landscapes.

name: Goa Beaches
headline: Golden Shores, Endless Sunsets
description: From the lively shores of North Goa to the tranquil coves of the south, Goa's beaches offer a rare blend of Portuguese colonial charm, tropical warmth, and a laid-back rhythm that invites travellers to arrive, breathe, and simply be.
